body:
Synchronize offline model reference artifacts, skill lens tables, website documentation, and esbuild bundles with the post-November-30-2026 Antigravity model catalog.

Objectives:
1. Run AGB_SYNC_MODELS_OFFLINE=1 npm run sync:models to regenerate skills/adversarial-review/references/models.json.
2. Update ARL lens tables in skills/code-review/SKILL.md and skills/plan-review/SKILL.md to reference gemini-4-neon-* and gemini-4-hydrogen-* instead of retiring gemini-4-argon-* and gemini-3.8-flash-*.
3. Update website/content/docs/{concepts/pools-and-tiers,concepts/prosecution,guides/review,reference/agy-integration}.mdx and website/generated/modules.mdx for Hydrogen fast sub-pool, Neon default, post-GPT quota groups, and same-family-fallback prosecution.
4. Rebuild dist/agb.mjs and dist/mcp-server.mjs with npm run build.

Acceptance criteria:
1. skills/adversarial-review/references/models.json and skill docs match lib/models.mjs. Verify: AGB_SYNC_MODELS_OFFLINE=1 node scripts/sync-models.mjs --check
2. Website reference generator passes with zero drift. Verify: node website/scripts/gen-reference.mjs --check
3. Bundles match fresh build and full test suite passes. Verify: npm run build && npm test
title: Sync skills, website reference docs, and dist bundles for post-Nov-30 catalog
